title: Infinite, 3D Head Scan
author: Lee Perry-Smith / Infinite Realities
adaptations: Repackaged original mesh with supplied photographic colour and tangent-space normal maps.
Texture orientation and normal-channel convention baked by Three.js GLTFExporter.
No generated anatomy, added facial expressions, or rig.
scope: Closed-eye neutral bust; rigid head/neck motion only. Shared library material ignores source RGB unless explicit detail is enabled.
